content: Tail gone, SA already down to 1.66. Now the azine, which is the part that actually carries activity. The pyridin-3-yl at atoms 3-8 puts its ring nitrogen meta to the amide N-H; what this target reads is an aryl-N(H)-azine linkage with the ring nitrogen ortho to a free donor, and moving that nitrogen off the ortho position measured 0.00 against 0.41 on otherwise identical molecules. Atom 2 is the amide nitrogen and the 2-3 bond to the pyridine is non-ring, so I can cut it and attach the correct arrangement in its place: a benzene bearing a 4-chloropyridin-2-ylamino meta to the attachment point. Meta rather than para is deliberate - it measured 0.50 against 0.41 - and the central ring stays otherwise bare, since every substituent I tried on it hurt the meta core. The expected product is N-{3-[(4-chloropyridin-2-yl)amino]phenyl}cyclobutanecarboxamide, the best molecule from the previous run. Rebuilding it costs one call and puts a strong parent in the population from generation 1 instead of generation 3.
